controls.label: Shape model
controls.description: Ellipsoid approximation of the published 2.1 × 1 × 1 km size estimate combining Deep Space 1 images and ground-based photometry. The equal short axes are part of that coarse estimate; resolved local terrain is not represented. Full approximation dimensions: 2.1 × 1 × 1 km. Arbitrary display pole and meridian. The published 226.4 ± 1.3 h estimate is synodic and is not installed as a sidereal spin or an observed pole. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
controls.title: Deep Space 1 size approximation
